AURIGA PORTABLE H2 LEAK DETECTOR
Production: Nagpur Sensors Lab: Mumbai sales@multinanosense.com Product Development: Bengaluru www.multinanosense.com AURIGA Portable Hydrogen Leak Detector
Product Features:

• Patented Solid State Electrochemical Hydrogen Sensor with Solid Electrolyte and Novel Reference Electrode. • Extremely Compact Design • Selective and Specific to Hydrogen • High Sensitivity to Minute Leaks – 10 ppm • Sub-second Response Time • Widest Operating Range • Over-Exposure Damage Resistant • Operating Life of 5 years • Audio & Visual Perception of H2 Leaks • Smart Algorithms for User Friendly Interactions • Long Duration Battery Backup • Probe Options & Extension Accessories • Single Hand Operation Variants • Internal Memory for Records • USB C-Type for Charging & Data Transfer • IP 67 Ingress Protection
Product Benefits:

• Enhanced Safety: User can pin-point very low levels of leak at very early stages and act proactively to fix the leaks. • Enhanced Operator Efficiency: Checking leaks takes 10X less time compared to traditional H 2 leak detectors, due to sub-second response and recovery time. • Design Advantage: Small and easy to handle . Extended and flexible probe design enables insertion of the probe into high or small and space constrained locations. • No Damage on Over-Exposure: Sensor can be taken as close to the leak source as needed, without worrying about sensor damage. • Saves operational cost: No false alarms avoiding unnecessary down time. • Comprehensive AMC: Periodic calibration and cashless product replacement even beyond warranty period. • Product Upgrade Plans: Buy back options to upgrade your safety systems with our latest and best in class offerings.

Production: Nagpur Sensors Lab: Mumbai sales@multinanosense.com Product Development: Bengaluru www.multinanosense.com Storage Conditions 0℃ to +45℃. RH% < 90%. Store in a cool and dry place. Device must be stored in power OFF mode. Carrying case included. Area of Deployment Safe Area. This instrument should not be deployed in a Hazardous Area. Compatible Batteries 3 x Rechargeable AA Ni-MH batteries with over-charging protection and battery diagnostics. Batteries supplied in packed condition separately. Compatible Charger Standard USB C-Type charger used with mobile phones. Charger to be ordered separately. Battery Life on Single Full Charge 12 hours to 24 hours based on the number of times H2 is detected and power consumed by the buzzer and other visual indications. Resistant to Over-Range Exposure No damage on short term exposure to even 100% pure Hydrogen 1. In-house lab tested for 15 second exposure to 100% pure Hydrogen. 2. In-house lab tested for 5 minutes exposure to 40% Hydrogen in Nitrogen. 3. In-house lab tested for 10 minutes exposure to 20% Hydrogen in Methane. Single Shot Calibration User-friendly calibration routine taking less than 10 minutes, using a single certified reference gas mixture. Calibration kit can be ordered as an accessory. Recommended cycle: Once in every 6 months. Mandatory cycle: Once in every 12 months. Display OLED display with H2 concentration, leak intensity bar graph, sensor status, battery status and icons for operating mode, low alarm, high alarm and danger level. Flashing over-range indication. Soft Touch Buttons Multi-function soft touch buttons for Power ON/ OFF and Sleep Mode toggling, Menu / Return to Previous Screen, Up, Down, Left, Right and Enter. Multiple Operating Modes Easy access menu for choosing operating modes: 1. Leak Detection 2. Calibration 3. Diagnostic 4. Computer Interface Concentration Display Volumetric Measurement: XXXX PPM or XX.XX vol% Automated switchover from PPM to vol% range at user selectable threshold. %LEL Measurement: XXX.X % LEL User can manually toggle the concentration display between volumetric or % LEL unit of measurement. Alarm Levels User settable Low Alarm and High Alarm levels. The screen will display Low and High alarm icons and play different tones when the respective thresholds are crossed. Danger Level The screen shall display a danger icon when the measured H2 concentration equals or exceeds 4 vol% or 100% LEL. Over-Range Indication If the H2 concentration exceeds the Span value of the instrument, the concentration readout will be replaced with a flashing OVERRANGE message. Visual Cue Background colour inversion upon sensing H2 for immediate peripheral visual alert. Multi-tone Buzzer Sensor alive beeps.

Production: Nagpur Sensors Lab: Mumbai sales@multinanosense.com Product Development: Bengaluru www.multinanosense.com Multi-beat tones with increasing frequency and intensity proportional to H2 levels detected for instantaneous independent auditory perception of H2 leaks detected. Data Recording & Internal Storage Dedicated recording mode with Main Location and Sub Location tagging. Variants for storing up to 20 / 100 / 200 records of 30 seconds each. Computer Interface USB C cable for interface with computer for data transfer and advanced dashboard features like graphs, diagnostic and device management on the computer.

Smart Algorithms Start-Up Routine Interactive routine to ensure instrument is powered on in H2 free ambient Air for automated ZeroCal and Probe status check. Power Off Routine Interactive routine to ensure the instrument is safely powered off and all session readings and internal values are stored safely. Zero Drift Correction Automatic + Manual ZeroCal Automatic + Manual ZeroCal Automatic + Manual ZeroCal Sensor Readiness Check Internally detects the sensor readiness for detecting low leaks (up to 100ppm) and high leaks (above 100ppm) Over-Range Recovery Mode Internally diagnoses an over-exposure event and processes sensor recovery for readiness to check H2 leaks again within 10 minutes. Sleep Mode The device has a power saving feature to manually turn off the display. Wake button can be used to bring the device into operating mode. Manual Override Flexibility for user to perform ZeroCal on the go for quick leak checks. Diagnostic Mode for Probe Dedicated mode for availing on-line technical support to troubleshoot issue or optimize performance according to the use case. Diagnostic Mode for Monitor Dedicated mode to check the health of display, buttons, and buzzer.

Monitor Physical Details Hand held display unit is a rugged and sleek plastic body with soft touch buttons. Dimensions 145 x 88 x 34 (L X B X H) in mm. Material of Construction Hard shell: ABS. Grips: TPE Weight 300 gms approx. (With batteries) Sensor Probe A rugged stainless steel/aluminium machined probe with the sensor at the probe tip. Dimensions Total length: 260mm. Handle OD: ø24mm Probe Connecting Cable Up to 1500mm cable to connect the Sensor Probe with the Monitor. Sensing Surface Position Sensor is housed at the tip of the probe for ultra-high sensitivity and suction free operation. Gas Exposure Method Diffusion. Gas exposure aperture Ø 3mm. Weight Up to 400 grams
